Why would the United States replace the Electoral College? For close to 60 elections now they have used it, so if you've had it for so long why would you change it? Also, Trump causing the death of the Republican Party is stupid. Nixon did worse and the GOP still lives on. Everything on this page is bullshit.

P.S why do they use the FPTP even if the 2-round system is better?!
